symptom: find / filter / sort / an aggregate by a member the list's entity does not have (`find $l by Numbr = '42'`, `sum $l by Totl`) passed `check -p` and exec; mx check CE1613 "The selected attribute 'Shop.Order.Numbr' no longer exists." once per activity. Also: `sum $sl by Total` with Total INHERITED was written as `Shop.SubOrd.Total` (CE1613) though the member exists
cause: resolveMemberChange (reached through resolveListOperationMember), the sort branch and the aggregate all fell back to writing `<entity>.<name>` when the name resolved to nothing; the aggregate never walked the generalization chain at all. check --references resolved CREATE/CHANGE members (#1048) and retrieve constraints (#1213) but no list-operation member
file: `mdl/executor/member_verdict.go` (new: memberVerdictOver, the one chain walk, with backendMemberModel; flowMemberVerdict; listMemberRefusal), `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go` (refuseMissingListMember in find/filter/sort/aggregate; aggregate qualifies with the declaring entity), `mdl/executor/validate_flow_member_refs.go` (scriptMemberModel, listMember), `mdl/executor/validate_member_refs.go` (resolveMemberOnEntity/nearMembers delegate)
insight: Make the builder refuse with the check's verdict and the check's words, instead of adding a check that predicts a builder which fabricates: one walk (memberVerdictOver) over a per-link interface, read from the backend by exec and from script-over-backend by check — the script overlay only changes how a LINK is read, never the walk, which is the duplicate-resolver-drift remedy taken literally. System dates are the trap: a sort reads `createdDate` where the root stores it (clean), but an aggregate cannot — `maximum $l by createdDate` is CE0226 'Entity ... does not contain attribute ...' even where stored. That was first measured as clean because the same app had a CE1613: **mx check reports neither CE0117 nor CE0226 while any CE1613 exists** — re-measure every control in an app with no other error
fix: find/filter by member, sort and aggregate refuse a bare member established as missing (exec without the preflight says exactly what check says, asserted); aggregates qualify an inherited attribute with its declaring entity; an aggregate over a system date is refused naming CE0226
